intro.text: A young Thaylen merchant's apprentice, learning to trade under her babsk, Vstim.
A young Thaylen woman who, after an accident on a trading voyage cost her the use of her legs, works at the Thaylen Gemstone Reserve.
A Thaylen tradesmaster and the rebsk of the ship Wandersail, who keeps a pet larkin named Chiri-Chiri.
A Thaylen tradesmaster and the rebsk of the Wandersail, with a pet larkin named Chiri-Chiri. She is a Dawnshard.

items.text: Five months into her apprenticeship, Rysn went with Vstim to Shinovar to trade Soulcast metal for chickens, cloth and exotic meats. She found the place strange, and called the Shin grass imbecilic, so Vstim made her keep a pot of it until it no longer seemed odd. Watching Vstim and the Shin trader Thresh each run down their own wares, she learned that the humble Shin think it more honest to undervalue goods than to overstate them.
The goods they bought from the Shin turned out to be very profitable. Rysn named her pot of grass Tyvnk, Thaylen for "sullen", letting the grass be sullen about Vstim being right instead of her.

On a trading trip to the Reshi Isles, Rysn fell from the greatshell island Relu-na, which slowed her fall and saved her life, but her legs were shattered and she would never walk again. She realised that Vstim had arranged the whole meeting so she could practise negotiating, and that the Reshi would now trade with her again. They had come for a larkin's corpse, but Relu-na gave her a live one for her bravery.

Thinking her career as a trader was over, Rysn took a job at the Thaylen Gemstone Reserve, keeping only the Shin grass and Chiri-Chiri from her travels. Vstim came to audit the Reserve himself and offered her the captain's cord to a fine ship, the Wandersail.

When a traitor among the queen's guards seized the King's Drop, Rysn dragged herself across the vault floor, tied the gem to her leg, and rigged a fallen guard's crossbow to her chair with the captain's cord. As Chiri-Chiri drained the traitor's Voidlight, she shot him. Dalinar Kholin later found her beside the injured Vstim, and she told him the enemy had stolen the King's Drop.

A few months after the Battle of Thaylen Field, Talik told Rysn that the ailing Chiri-Chiri needed to return to her home, the lost city of Akinah on Aimia. When Navani Kholin sought a ship for an expedition there, Rysn agreed to send the Wandersail in exchange for the Windrunners Lopen and Huio as protection, the ardent Rushu to work on a mobility fabrial for her, and a royal mandate from Queen Fen for her crew.

At sea, Rysn found that Captain Drlwan and the crew resented Vstim choosing her as rebsk. She had her porter, Nikli, start a playful hazing ritual to win them over, and bonded with Lopen over their shared experience of disability and with Rushu over fabrials.

Rysn won the crew's respect by handling a run of bad omens: she traded infested grain to Hexi nomads for jerky, and turned a dead santhid into a good omen and a chance to rest ashore. There Rushu built a prototype levitating chair for her. Vstim then warned her that the Windrunners and Rushu had secret orders to find Akinah's Oathgate.

When the omens proved to be Nikli's doing, Rysn had him put off the ship. The Wandersail went on through the storm around Akinah, where Chiri-Chiri leapt overboard. Rysn was the first to see that the gemhearts on the shore were fake and a trap had been set. When Nikli returned to the ship, Cord grabbed Rysn and jumped into the water.

Luckspren led Rysn and Cord to caverns under the island holding Shardplate, eight Soulcasters and a mural of the Shattering of Adonalsium. Gazing at the mural, Rysn unknowingly took the Dawnshard into herself.

Rysn won the crew safe passage home with the Shardplate and Soulcasters by vowing to protect the Dawnshard, so it would no longer be at Akinah, and agreed that Sleepless could follow her for good. A cover story was arranged for the public and another for Roshar's rulers.

As they sailed from Aimia, Drlwan acknowledged that Rysn had put the crew before her own safety and asked her to take the helm on their next voyage. Rysn noticed that she now saw colours better and that voices sounded more musical.

Rysn told Vstim the truth about the Sleepless, despite her agreement with them, and he promised to keep her secrets. After he left, Chiri-Chiri spoke to her in the human tongue, starting with her name.

Rysn persuaded the coalition to adopt Thaylen patent law, and held a patent with her business partner Huio. At a meeting about it, Hoid revealed himself to her, and she sensed that he was a Dawnshard too. Their Dawnshards began pulling them violently together until Hoid stopped it and left, promising they would never meet again. Rysn quickly planned to go into hiding with her Sleepless companions.

appearance.text: Rysn has the long white Thaylen eyebrows, which she tucks behind her ears. She usually wears a vest over a long-sleeved shirt and an ankle-length skirt, with a glove on her safehand.
She cannot use her legs, and gets about by wheelchair, porter or palanquin, and later in a levitating fabrial "freechair".

personality.text: Rysn thinks covering the safehand is a silly tradition left over from Vorin cultural dominance, though she does it anyway.

Trained by Vstim, she is a good judge of character and a determined bargainer. Her biggest fault, by his account, is her prejudice against other nations and cultures, though she makes great strides against it.
